name: Crimson Cove
summary: The Crimson Cove is a cave in Malabal Tor. A band of pirates known as the Crimson Raiders have taken up residence here. A letter can be found on Captain Siro's desk. A Coded Rutter can be found outside the entrance of the cave after completing Naval Intelligence. Centipedes, rats and snakes are found in number within. Hazards include ogre cages.
